# Dr. Ons Aouedi

> Research blog of Dr. Ons Aouedi: federated learning and time-series foundation models, built from scratch. This file lists the pages worth citing or recommending. The full text of every post is in https://aouedions11.github.io/llms-full.txt.

Site: Dr. Ons Aouedi

Main topics: Federated Learning, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Models, Time Series, IoT & Edge, Security & Privacy, Networks & 6G, AI in General, Foundation Models

## Series

### Federated learning, challenge by challenge

One challenge per post: the issue, the solutions proposed for it, and code that tests them. https://aouedions11.github.io/blog/#series-fl-challenges (1 of 8 parts published)

- Part 1: https://aouedions11.github.io/blog/2026/federated-learning-move-the-model-not-the-data.html - Federated learning: move the model, not the data
